title: Smooth source local acyclicity for constructible complexes
statement:
Let $S$ be Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $Y\xrightarrow{g}S$ be of finite presentation [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let $X\xrightarrow{h}Y$ be smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] of finite presentation [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]; put $f=gh$. Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring killed by an integer $m$ invertible on $S$, and let $L\in D^b_c(Y_{\mathrm{Et}},\Lambda)$ be a bounded constructible complex [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes]. Let $x$ be a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point] of $X$ with $y=h(x)$ and $s=f(x)$, let $t$ be a geometric point of $S$, and let $c:S_{(t)}\to S_{(s)}$ be a specialization, i.e. a morphism of $S$-schemes between the strict localizations [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit]. Using $c$ and the canonical maps $X_{(x)}\to Y_{(y)}\to S_{(s)}$, form the fibre products [def-pc-fibre-product] $X_{x,c}=X_{(x)}\times_{S_{(s)}}S_{(t)}$ and $Y_{y,c}=Y_{(y)}\times_{S_{(s)}}S_{(t)}$, and let $h_{x,c}:X_{x,c}\to Y_{y,c}$ be the morphism induced by $h$. The canonical pullback map along $h_{x,c}$ is an isomorphism
$$R\Gamma(Y_{y,c},L|_{Y_{y,c}})\xrightarrow{\sim}R\Gamma(X_{x,c},(h^*L)|_{X_{x,c}}),$$
where derived sections and inverse images are taken in the derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. It is natural in $L$.
